title: Verify and revise with CLEAR
learner_promise: Review your Lesson 2.2 communication with CLEAR, verify an important claim, and retain a useful revision with its human approval status and remaining limits.

pacing.label: Personal CLEAR review and evidence standards
Unsupported commitment, critique and source check
Review, verify and revise your communication
Applied correction and human approval evidence

outcomes: Apply Correct, Listener, Enough, Appropriate and Responsible to the saved draft.
Compare your own review with AI critique and explain a decision about a suggestion.
Verify a material claim against an authoritative source or approved record.
Revise unsupported facts, audience tone and a missing next action.
Record the source and check date, human approval status and remaining limits.

teaching.heading: Review personally before asking for critique
paragraphs: Read your Lesson 2.2 draft beside its intended purpose and audience. Under every CLEAR category, name a finding and a reason. Correct checks facts and instructions; Listener checks audience fit; Enough checks gaps and repetition; Appropriate checks tone and setting; Responsible checks privacy, fairness, risk, authority and accountability.
Separate an attractive sentence from a supported claim. Mark approvals, dates and promises that could change a decision. Check whether the reader can act without guessing.
teaching.think_prompt: Which sentence needs evidence, and which sentence leaves the recipient unsure what to do?

teaching.heading: Use critique as additional input
paragraphs: Ask your own AI assistant to examine the same five categories using only authorized material. Compare its suggestions with your personal findings. Accept, revise or reject each important suggestion with a reason.
A model reviewing its own output is not independent evidence. Agreement from another model also does not establish an internal promise. Check the actual source.
teaching.think_prompt: What did the AI critique catch or miss, and would any suggested wording change the factual meaning?

teaching.heading: Check an exact material claim
paragraphs: Write the exact claim and identify a source with authority over it. Compare scope, conditions, version and exceptions. Record the source and the actual check date. Protect private records by saving only an authorized citation or necessary extract.
A five-day delivery promise requires confirmed capacity for that job. A general statement about typical delivery cannot supply that approval. Verify, qualify accurately or remove an uncertain claim.
teaching.think_prompt: Does your source support the exact promise, or only a different outcome or condition?

teaching.heading: Revise and retain the approval boundary
paragraphs: Correct the unsupported meaning, audience tone and missing action. Recheck all five CLEAR categories after editing. Name the person with authority to approve wording and any commitments.

Obtain human approval before real use. If approval remains pending, retain a reviewed draft awaiting approval. Label fictional approval routes as simulated. Save the before version, checks, revision and limits in Prompt and Communication Evidence.
teaching.think_prompt: Who can approve the communication, and what still prevents it from being treated as approved?

worked_case.label: A polished proposal promises capacity that has not been confirmed
worked_case.setup: FICTIONAL TRAINING EXAMPLE: “Your estimate is approved; delivery is guaranteed in five days. Supply the outstanding specifications immediately.” The fictional intake record confirms only review within two business days after complete inputs arrive. Room dimensions and a preferred appointment date are missing. Appointment booking requires the scheduling owner’s approval. Estimate approval and delivery capacity are not confirmed.

evidence_table.evidence: The fictional record shows an incomplete request; no estimate approval is supplied.
evidence_table.action: Remove the invented approval and state the review stage accurately.

evidence_table.claim: Delivery is guaranteed in five days.
evidence_table.evidence: Capacity has not been confirmed. The record provides a review period only.
evidence_table.action: Remove the delivery promise. Changing guaranteed to expected does not verify it.

evidence_table.evidence: Room dimensions and a preferred appointment date are the missing details; no urgent deadline is authorized.
evidence_table.action: Request both in plain, respectful language without invented urgency.

evidence_table.claim: AI says this version is verified and approved.
evidence_table.evidence: AI critique is additional input. The source check and authorized human approval are separate actions.
evidence_table.action: Record independent source evidence and the actual human approval status.

worked_case.revised_example: Thank you for your estimate request. Please reply with the room dimensions and your preferred appointment date. After we receive complete information, our team will review your request within two business days. We will confirm the estimate and schedule after the appropriate review. No appointment or delivery date is confirmed by this message.
demonstration_steps: Compare critique without treating it as proof
Check the claim against its source
Revise and preserve the approval boundary
worked_case.question: Which correction fixes the unsupported commitment, which helps the customer act, and who may approve the final message?

application.heading: Review the saved communication yourself
application.instruction: Continue with the same project and Lesson 2.2 communication. Record one finding and reason under each CLEAR category before asking AI. Identify the recipient action and material claims.
application.evidence: Original draft, audience and five personal CLEAR findings.

application.heading: Compare critique and verify a claim
application.instruction: Use the approved request with your own AI assistant and authorized source material. Compare its critique with your judgment. Verify at least one exact material claim against an authoritative source or approved record; record source, version or date, actual check date and result.
application.evidence: AI critique, decision about a suggestion and independent claim-check evidence.

application.heading: Revise and identify the approval route
application.instruction: Correct the draft and explain useful changes. Obtain approval before real use; mark pending approval accurately. Save the original, revised communication, approval status and remaining limits. Complete the fictional applied correction without sending a message.
application.evidence: Revision, rationale, authorized approver, actual status and applied correction.

approved_ai_request: Critique this draft under Correct, Listener, Enough, Appropriate and Responsible. Flag unsupported claims and missing information. Do not assert that facts are verified. Draft and approved sources: [inputs].
responsibility_map_fields: Source date or version and actual check date
Remaining limits and decision before real use

verification.heading: Correct all three applied problems
verification.prompt: Revise the fictional draft containing an invented fact, unsuitable audience tone and missing next action. Explain a correction for each.

verification.heading: Explain independent verification
verification.prompt: Show the exact claim, source, check date and result. Explain why AI self-review alone is insufficient.

verification.heading: Retain approval status and limits
verification.prompt: Identify the authorized approver. Distinguish actual approval from pending or simulated approval, and save the evidence in your existing Project Record.

completion_criteria: Personal findings under all five CLEAR categories
AI critique compared with your own review and a decision explained
At least one material claim checked against an authoritative source or approved record
Source identity, available date or version, check date and verification result recorded
Revised communication with useful changes explained
Applied correction of invented fact, tone and missing next action
Human approval status and remaining limits saved without overwriting Lesson 2.2 evidence
handoff: Carry your reviewed communication, source checks and human approval points into Lesson 2.4: Choose Assistants, Automation and Agents. The next lesson opens according to its release schedule.
